# AddToAny
> Universal sharing platform providing share buttons, follow buttons, and related tools for websites, apps, and publishers.

AddToAny helps site owners add customizable sharing interfaces that work across social networks, messaging apps, email, and other destinations. Its site includes setup guides, platform-specific plugins, customization options, and developer resources.

## Getting Started
- [AddToAny Home](https://www.addtoany.com/): Overview of universal share buttons, features, and setup options for websites and apps.
- [Get the Share Buttons](https://www.addtoany.com/buttons/): Main entry point for generating and configuring AddToAny share buttons.
- [Share Buttons FAQ](https://www.addtoany.com/faq/): Answers to common questions about setup, behavior, and supported services.
- [Services Directory](https://www.addtoany.com/services/): Browse supported social networks, apps, and sharing destinations.
- [Icons](https://www.addtoany.com/buttons/customize/icons): Customize icon style, size, colors, and appearance for share buttons.

## Web Platform Documentation
- [Website Share Buttons](https://www.addtoany.com/buttons/for/website): Setup instructions for adding share buttons to a website.
- [HTML Share Buttons](https://www.addtoany.com/buttons/customize/html): Use HTML markup to place and configure AddToAny buttons manually.
- [JavaScript API](https://www.addtoany.com/buttons/api/): Developer reference for JavaScript configuration, events, and dynamic behavior.
- [Menu Customization](https://www.addtoany.com/buttons/customize/menu): Configure the sharing menu, included services, and interaction behavior.
- [Universal Share Button](https://www.addtoany.com/buttons/customize/share-button): Customize the main universal share button label and presentation.
- [Follow Buttons](https://www.addtoany.com/buttons/for/follow-buttons): Add follow buttons linking visitors to social profiles and channels.

## Customization
- [Button Customization](https://www.addtoany.com/buttons/customize/): Central hub for customizing AddToAny button appearance and behavior.
- [Icon Customization](https://www.addtoany.com/buttons/customize/icons): Adjust icon sets, colors, shapes, and responsive sizing.
- [Share Counter](https://www.addtoany.com/buttons/customize/share-counter): Enable and configure share counters for supported services.
- [Floating Share Buttons](https://www.addtoany.com/buttons/customize/floating-share-buttons): Create floating share bars for desktop and mobile layouts.
- [Placement Options](https://www.addtoany.com/buttons/customize/placement): Control where buttons appear within pages and templates.
- [Responsive Buttons](https://www.addtoany.com/buttons/customize/responsive): Configure mobile-friendly and responsive sharing button behavior.

## CMS and Ecommerce Plugins
- [WordPress Share Buttons Plugin](https://www.addtoany.com/buttons/for/wordpress): Install and configure AddToAny for WordPress sites.
- [WooCommerce Share Buttons](https://www.addtoany.com/buttons/for/woocommerce): Add sharing tools to WooCommerce product and store pages.
- [Drupal Share Buttons](https://www.addtoany.com/buttons/for/drupal): Integrate AddToAny sharing into Drupal websites.
- [Joomla Share Buttons](https://www.addtoany.com/buttons/for/joomla): Setup instructions for Joomla-based sites.
- [Blogger Share Buttons](https://www.addtoany.com/buttons/for/blogger): Add sharing tools to Blogger blogs and posts.
- [Tumblr Share Buttons](https://www.addtoany.com/buttons/for/tumblr): Configure AddToAny for Tumblr themes and content.

## Developer Resources
- [API Reference](https://www.addtoany.com/buttons/api/): Technical reference for JavaScript methods, configuration, and callbacks.
- [Service Codes](https://www.addtoany.com/services/): Find service identifiers and supported destinations for custom integrations.
- [Custom HTML Buttons](https://www.addtoany.com/buttons/customize/html): Build custom button layouts using AddToAny markup patterns.
- [URL Parameters](https://www.addtoany.com/buttons/customize/url): Control shared URLs, titles, and related metadata.
- [Google Analytics Integration](https://www.addtoany.com/buttons/customize/google-analytics): Track sharing interactions with Google Analytics.
- [Asynchronous Loading](https://www.addtoany.com/buttons/customize/async): Load AddToAny efficiently in modern web environments.

## Mobile and Apps
- [Share Buttons for Apps](https://www.addtoany.com/buttons/for/apps): Overview of AddToAny sharing options for mobile and app contexts.
- [Android Sharing](https://www.addtoany.com/buttons/for/android): Guidance for integrating AddToAny with Android experiences.
- [iPhone and iPad Sharing](https://www.addtoany.com/buttons/for/iphone): Sharing support information for iPhone and iPad environments.
- [Mobile Responsive Buttons](https://www.addtoany.com/buttons/customize/responsive): Optimize share buttons for smaller screens and touch interfaces.
- [Floating Mobile Share Bar](https://www.addtoany.com/buttons/customize/floating-share-buttons): Configure floating sharing UI for mobile visitors.

## Platform Features
- [Share Counters](https://www.addtoany.com/buttons/customize/share-counter): Display social share counts where supported.
- [Floating Share Bars](https://www.addtoany.com/buttons/customize/floating-share-buttons): Add persistent vertical or horizontal sharing bars.
- [Google Analytics](https://www.addtoany.com/buttons/customize/google-analytics): Measure share activity with analytics integration.
- [Universal Sharing Menu](https://www.addtoany.com/buttons/customize/menu): Let visitors share to many services from one interface.
- [No Account Necessary](https://www.addtoany.com/): Use AddToAny without requiring an account for basic setup.
- [Highly Customizable Buttons](https://www.addtoany.com/buttons/customize/): Tailor styles, services, placement, and behavior.
